subject: Security QA & procurement path — alignment and evidence delivery
body_text:
--- Message 1/4 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medallion.health>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medallion.health>, procurement@medallion.health, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Security QA & procurement path — alignment and evidence delivery

Hi Laura / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of where Medallion is at: 
- Pilot approval from Product & Infra teams pending security Q/A.
- Procurement prefers a standard SOW + PO path; legal will surface a couple of non-standard T&Cs.
- Timeline goal: pilot start by Jan 10 (internal).

Decision / stakeholder map (as we understood):
- Economic buyer: Laura Chen (Product) — owns pilot success criteria and budget sign-off.
- Security reviewer: Rajiv Patel (Security) — needs SOC 2 artifact, pen-test summary, audit-log retention answers.
- Procurement lead: procurement@medallion.health — will own contract intake and PO issuance.

Immediate asks from Medallion (from call):
1) Redacted SOC 2 report or SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted acceptable)
2) High-level pen-test summary and remediation posture
3) Answers to three data-retention & logs questions (attached doc)
4) Confirmation of who signs SOW and expected PO lead time

Proposed Redwood deliverables & timeline: 
- Today (Dec 5): initial package with SOC2 redaction guidance + pen-test summary + answers doc (we’ll send redacted SOC2 and the other two as attachments).
- Dec 7: follow-up call slot to walk Rajiv through artifacts (30 minutes).
- Dec 10–14: procurement receives SOW draft; legal redlines consolidated by Medallion; aim to finalize SOW for PO.

Internal (Ben / Marissa): please review the attached artifacts for redaction suitability and confirm we’re okay sharing with Medallion. If we need a bespoke confidentiality addendum, flag today.

Next steps: 
- Laura/Rajiv: confirm if the redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary are sufficient for initial pilot approval, or whether you need full reports / additional evidence.
- Procurement: confirm the name/email of the procurement lead and expected PO lead time once SOW is shared.

Thanks — want to keep momentum on the timetable.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_v3_redacted.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: pen_test_summary.pdf (pdf, 480KB)]
[Attachment: data-retention-answers.docx (docx, 45KB)]

--- Message 2/4 (external reply) ---
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medallion.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medallion.health>, procurement@medallion.health
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 11:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security QA & procurement path — alignment and evidence delivery

Karthik — thanks for the notes and the quick turnaround.

A couple quick clarifications: 
- For the SOC2, a redacted Type II report is what Rajiv’s team prefers for an initial risk review.
- For the pen-test summary: we need at minimum scope, date, high-level findings and whether critical issues were remediated. No raw vuln lists.
- The data-retention Q&A you attached is perfect — we’ll use that in our risk matrix.

We’re good for the Dec 7 walk-through. Can you do 9:00am PT? Procurement will follow up separately about SOW formatting; expected PO timing is typically 3–4 weeks after SOW finalization (but we’ll confirm).

Laura
Director, Product — Medallion Health

--- Message 3/4 (internal note) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 5 Dec 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Security QA & procurement path — alignment and evidence delivery

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for sending. Quick internal items: 
- I reviewed the SOC2 redaction checklist — looks fine but we should remove a few internal hostnames from the appendix. I’ll mark them and send an updated PDF by EOD.
- For the pen-test summary, the vendor provided a one-page executive summary; I suggest we include a short remediation timeline note (30/60/90) so Rajiv sees our posture.
- Procurement: if Medallion pushes non-standard indemnity language, let Marissa lead the legal negotiation; we’ll offer a limited liability cap tied to pilot scope.

I’ll attach the redacted SOC2 and the edited pen-test summary in the follow-up.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_v3_redacted.pdf (updated, pdf, 1.1MB)]
[Attachment: pen_test_summary.pdf (updated, pdf, 520KB)]

--- Message 4/4 (final external confirmation) ---
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@medallion.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medallion.health>, procurement@medallion.health
Date: Wed, 7 Dec 2027 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security QA & procurement path — alignment and evidence delivery

Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the materials and the walkthrough earlier today. Quick notes from my security review: 
- Redacted SOC2 (v3) is sufficient for pilot gating. Thanks for the clean redactions.
- Pen-test summary looks good; appreciate the remediation timeline. A short note on log retention (we discussed 90 days for audit logs, archive for 12 months) should be added to the answers doc — I’ve added a comment in the Drive doc.
- A couple of minor questions on data residency for backups — I opened them in the Drive Q&A.

Overall: green for pilot to proceed to procurement + SOW. Procurement — please initiate SOW intake once Redwood uploads the final SOW draft to the DocuSign link.

Rajiv Patel
Security Engineering Manager
Medallion Health

[Forwarded/Referenced attachments: SOC2_v3_redacted.pdf, pen_test_summary.pdf, data-retention-answers.docx]

--- End of thread ---
